{{Quote|It looks like a giant skipper squid exploded on the battlefield, sir&hellip; I can't take two steps without putting my boot into blue slime.|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes|<ref name="NEGWT" />}}
A '''skipper squid''' was a creature that the<ref name="NEGWT" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="BattleForNaboo">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref> [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] was familiar with.<ref name="NEGWT" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] used large amounts of<ref name="NEGWT" /> [[Booma/Legends|boomas]],<ref name="DB GunganWeaponry">{{DB|technology|gunganweaponry|Gungan weaponry}}</ref> explosive [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] utilizing [[Color/Legends|blue]] slimy [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]],<ref name="NEGWT" /> against the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="DB GunganWeaponry" /> In a comment made to a superior in the battle's aftermath,<ref name="NEGWT" /> the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]-[[Naboo (people)/Legends|native]]<ref name="BattleForNaboo" /> Sykes compared the plasma slime-covered site of the engagement to a giant skipper [[Squid/Legends|squid]] having exploded at that location.<ref name="NEGWT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skipper squid was introduced in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' by [[W. Haden Blackman]].<ref name="NEGWT" />
